_comment: Auditable allow-list of INTENDED stroke direction / endpoint changes for G7 (scripts/audit_invariants.py). An entry admits exactly one (reference stroke, candidate stroke) pair, bound by stroke index and sha256 of each checkpoint list (g7_stroke_digest); any further edit to the stroke un-allows it. Add an entry only for a change that was decided on purpose, with the reason, and date it. Entries for other letters/weights never match.
